name: Until Death and After
source:
The main character, Lilian, a sweet and bubbly girl, spends her summer break hanging around her best friend Tessa and her friends Elisa and Millie. 

Going out for ice cream, going to the mall, everything is great! 

Until she meets a certain girl on a fated day, instantly sending her heart into a flutter.
translation:
主角莉莲是一个甜美活泼的女孩，暑假期间她和她最好的朋友泰莎以及她的朋友艾丽莎和米莉在一起度过。

出去吃冰淇淋，逛商场，一切都很棒！

直到她在某个命中注定的日子遇见了某个女孩，瞬间让她心动不已。
